body:
## 🐛 Bug Report
Get errors when setting `FlatList` - `debug={true}`
![Simulator Screen Shot - iPhone 8 - 2019-03-20 at 14 24 55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7344724/54663617-d23ea880-4b1c-11e9-9de8-4749c446df93.png)

## To Reproduce
```sh
cd Destop && react-native init VirtualListDebugDemo && cd VirtualListDebugDemo && react-native run-ios
```

## Expected Behavior
debug mode work fine

## Code Example
Edit the App.js:

```jsx
import React, { Component } from 'react'
import { Text, FlatList } from 'react-native'

export default class App extends Component {
  render() {
    return (
      <FlatList
        //  ❌ Un-commit this line to see error
        // debug={true}
        data={[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]}
        renderItem={_ => {
          return <Text>123</Text>
        }}
        keyExtractor={item => item.toString()}
      />
    )
  }
}

```
